title: Local-file mounts rewrite a cache entry on every request
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: execution/source_cache.ex:146-150, :194-199; cache.ex:125-135. Defaults (verify: :stat, origin freshness 0) revalidate every request; on :not_modified remember/4 still runs Input.refresh + Cache.remember_source: mkdir, temp body, temp meta, two renames and, bounded, an Admission.commit, even when the result is cached. Per-key Work lock (cache/work.ex:14-24) serialises popular files. An output miss on a file source also fetches and remembers twice (execution.ex:297-315, source_cache.ex:242).
Fix: skip the write when only received_at changed and the record still can't become fresh or stale.
Next: benchmark concurrent warm requests for one local file.

title: Admission lookups scan whole ETS tables on every cache hit
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: cache/file_system/admission.ex:677, :755, :846. Queues are :ordered_set keyed {pos, hash}; lookups by hash use :ets.match_object(table, {{:_, hash}, :_}), a full scan. A hit cast runs locate twice across three tables (up to six scans) inside the single Admission GenServer; source-record lookups count as hits.
Fix: add a :set index hash -> {queue, pos} and pass the located result to promote_on_hit.
Impact: O(N) -> O(1); at ~100k entries each scan is ms, so at a few hundred hits/s the mailbox grows, commits pass the 5 s timeout and writes drop as :admission_unavailable. Boot directory scan is O(N^2) too (admission.ex:305-347, :450, :540-556; each .meta read twice).
Next: benchmark a bounded pool with ~100k entries under concurrent hits.

title: Decide default AVIF/WebP encoder effort
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/processing/config.ex:36-37 default %WebpOptions{}/%AvifOptions{} with effort: nil, so encoder.ex:205 uses libvips' default effort 4; with auto_avif every AVIF-accepting browser pays it.
Measured (pyvips, libvips 8.15): at matched SSIMULACRA2 quality, AVIF effort 3 is ~4x faster than e4 for ~12-15% more bytes (beach 1200px: 560 ms -> 117 ms). WebP e2 is ~2.5x faster than e4 for 4-6% more bytes. Auto-quality AVIF pays the encode per probe (~3 probes, ~1.5-2.5 s at e4 for 1200-1600 px).
Options: lower defaults (AVIF 2-3, WebP 2-3), or keep 4 and document the latency next to avif_options/webp_options. Follow-up idea: search probes at low effort with a per-effort quality offset (like quality_search_offsets), final encode at configured effort.
Needs decision: bytes vs latency product tradeoff.

title: Erlang distribution is on in the published Docker image with a shared, readable cookie
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: image_pipe_server/Dockerfile:108-129 sets no RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION or RELEASE_COOKIE; no rel/env.sh.
Cause: Mix releases default to RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=sname, so start runs epmd on 0.0.0.0:4369 plus a distribution listener on all interfaces. The cookie is generated at build time into /app/releases/COOKIE; every container of a tag shares it and anyone can read it from the image.
Impact: in k8s without a NetworkPolicy or on a shared Docker network, another container can connect with the public cookie: remote code execution as uid 10001.
Repro: run the image and check /proc/net/tcp for :10F1 (4369); or erl -sname x -setcookie $(cat COOKIE) and net_adm:ping from a sibling container.
Fix: ENV RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION=none in the runtime stage (breaks bin/image_pipe_server remote, undocumented), or bind distribution to loopback (ERL_EPMD_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1 + -kernel inet_dist_use_interface {127,0,0,1} in rel/vm.args.eex) and generate the cookie at container start.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Rotating S3 credentials break the cache and change ETags
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/source/s3.ex:281-285 (prepare_cache/3 writes current temporary credentials into fetch as {:static, credentials}); lib/image_pipe/source.ex:199-210 (prepare_cache_context/2 puts prepared.fetch into the cache context, which feeds Representation.input_key and, for stable S3 sources, the strong byte identity {seed, MaterialDigest.of(context)}). Also perf-review/sources-and-caching.md #4. HTTP auth: given as a fun/MFA behaves the same.
Effect: with InstanceRole, WebIdentity, AssumeRole or ContainerCredentials, each refresh (~hourly) misses every cached original and output and, for versioned objects, changes the ETag (breaks the AGENTS.md byte-identity ETag rule). Possibly the biggest hit-rate effect for S3 deployments.
Fix: partition by configured provider/options or access key ID, not secret or session token.
Needs decision: the comment at source.ex:191 suggests the current behaviour is intentional.
Test: a provider returning token t1 then t2; assert input_key hash and strong byte identity are unchanged.

title: Preset value with trailing newline crashes the request
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Where: image_pipe_url/lib/image_pipe/api/value.ex:13 (@nonneg_integer_pattern ~r/^[0-9]+$/), used by dimension/1 and pad_shorthand/1. Reproduced.
Cause: PCRE $ also matches before a final 
, so "10
" passes; String.to_integer("10
") then raises ArgumentError, unrescued. ImagePipe.Presets.parse/1 only rescues around fetch/2. A PresetLookup returning "w=400
" makes the request raise instead of {:preset, :invalid_definition} and 500; run/4 and validate/2 raise too.
Repro: ImagePipe.API.Presets.parse_fragment("w=10
") and "pad=1
" raise.
Fix: use \A...\z anchors as option_spec.ex does. @number_pattern and @css_name_pattern in the same file have the same anchor problem (callers currently fail safely).

title: Watermark failure leaks the staged source temp file
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/execution.ex:69-77 (code-checked).
Cause: when the main source is staged (prepare_remote) and Watermarks.await/1 errors, the else branch cancels tasks and drops the context including acquisition.lease. Callers only Execution.close/1 after a successful prepare, so the temp file (up to max_body_bytes) and its Resources entry live until the owner process exits (keep-alive connection or long-lived run/4 caller).
Trigger: HTTP source plus watermark_source pointing at a 404.
Fix: SourceCache.release(context.acquisition.lease) in that branch.

title: Bundled detectors get boxes in the wrong frame with orient=none
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/detector/image_vision/face.ex:61-65, objects.ex:156-163.
Cause: with orient=none the detect crop runs on storage-frame pixels that still carry the EXIF orientation tag. Image.FaceDetection.detect/2 autorotates and Image.Detection.detect/2 thumbnails (also autorotates), so boxes come back in the display frame. On an orientation-6 photo, orient=none/crop=1000,1000/detect=face gets an x/y-swapped focal point, or the box fails the bounds filter and silently falls back to attention.
Fix: remove the orientation field before calling the library, as terminal/lqip_css.ex:72 already does.

title: Odd-sized region crops start 1px too far right/down
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/operation/crop.ex:196-200 (code-checked).
Cause: the coordinate branch converts origin to centre and back (center_x = round(left + w/2); left = round(center_x - w/2)); Kernel.round rounds halves away from zero, so any odd width/height shifts the origin by +1. region=0,0,3,3 on a 10x10 image crops from (1,1). Contract says region origins are exact; all pixel-compared region tests use even sizes.
Fix: left = clamp(left_px, 0, image_width - crop_width) (same for top).
Test: pixel-compared region crop with odd width/height.
Note: a local fix commit already exists on branch claude/project-thread-s2qem3 but was never pushed.

title: Single-axis fit=stretch is shrunk on load, then upscaled back (blurry)
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/executor.ex:747-755 -> decode_planner.ex:102-103; executor/geometry.ex:78-81 (code-checked).
Cause: the decode target ignores fit. For stretch the :auto axis stays at full source size, but the planner shrinks by the one given axis. w=500/fit=stretch on a 4000x3000 JPEG decodes at 500x375 and stretches 375 rows back to 3000.
Fix: no decode target (or no shrink on the auto axis) for single-axis stretch.
Test: request-boundary pixel comparison of w=500/fit=stretch against a no-shrink baseline.

title: Review findings Oct 2026: bug hunt and performance review
description: Findings from the October 2026 static bug hunt and performance review at main 84eeac2. Write-ups: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/*.md and /mnt/project-files/perf-review/*.md (project shared files). One child epic per write-up; one issue per finding. Findings marked needs-decision need Håvard's call before implementation. Duplicate findings across write-ups are filed once and cross-referenced.

title: Derive VIPS_CONCURRENCY from the container CPU quota
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Nothing sets VIPS_CONCURRENCY; libvips sizes thread pools from g_get_num_processors() (affinity, not cgroup cpu.max), while OTP honours the quota. A 2-CPU pod on a 64-core node runs 64 libvips threads per in-flight image (reasoned, not measured).
Change: rel/env.sh.eex deriving VIPS_CONCURRENCY from /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max when unset; document in docs/server-deployment.md. Note: VIPS_CONCURRENCY=1 at saturation gave 17.4 vs 16.9 img/s and 15% lower peak RSS, but hurts single-request latency at low load.

title: Decide on a default processing pool for the server
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Where: lib/image_pipe_server/application.ex:100, docs/server-deployment.md:184: without [pool] every request processes at once.
Measured on 4 cores: 4 concurrent ~= throughput of 16 (15-16 vs 17 img/s) at ~1/3 peak memory (jemalloc 442 vs 1287 MB; glibc 1.5 vs 2.6 GB). Unbounded turns a burst into an OOM kill instead of 503s.
Proposal: default max_concurrency = online schedulers plus a small queue.
Needs decision: changes visible behaviour (503 under overload).

title: Use jemalloc (or MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2) in the server image
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Where: Dockerfile:112 (runtime ENV); no allocator setting anywhere.
Measured (C harness, libvips 8.18.7): 16 threads x 60 imgs peak RSS 2628 -> 1287 MB, after-load 1942 -> 327 MB; 4 threads peak 1509 -> 442 MB; throughput within ~5%. MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 gives most of the benefit with no dependency.
Change: install libjemalloc2 in the runtime stage and LD_PRELOAD it (resolve the arch-dependent path at build time).

title: Build libvips with highway SIMD
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Where: Dockerfile:25-29 build deps; add libhwy-dev (runtime package follows via ldd, Dockerfile:48-50).
Measured CPU (6000x4000): reduce 0.222 -> 0.116 s, resize 0.212 -> 0.119 s, gaussblur 0.360 -> 0.208 s, PNG resize 0.466 -> 0.392 s; sharpen and JPEG shrink-on-load unchanged. Biggest win for PNG/WebP/AVIF/JXL sources and blur/pixelate.
Verify with vips --vips-config | grep SIMD in the build stage.

title: Perf review: standalone server
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Cache hits hash the whole body, then re-read it to send; use sendfile
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: cache/file.ex:10-46 (non-:raw open, verify pass, rewind, send pass); response/sender.ex:131-160 (send_chunked, 64 KB chunk/2). Also perf-review/request-path.md #2. HEAD and 304-after-stale pay verification too; input-cache hits do the same before decode (cache/input.ex:91-104, ~5-15 ms on a 10 MB original).
Measured (request-path review): 50 KB 197 us today vs 42 us send-only :raw; 300 KB 593 vs 81 us; 2 MB 3,570 vs 326 us.
Fix: verify at write time; on hit check size vs metadata and send with Plug.Conn.send_file (kernel sendfile); don't open the body for HEAD/304. If integrity stays, sample it or hash while streaming and abort on mismatch (abort path in plug/runner.ex:44-65).
Caveat: send_file reopens by path; pin the inode (hold fd or hard-link) against eviction/replace between verify and send.

title: Perf review: sources and caching
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Cache headers computed twice per 200; [:http_cache, :prepare] fires twice
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md

Where: plug/runner.ex:122 (serve_context) and :141 (serve_output) both call context_headers/3 -> CachePolicy.generate/6 plus limit passes, emitting [:http_cache, :prepare] each time (response/cache_policy.ex:74-84).
Fix: compute once; recompute only when output.degraded?, or apply the no_store downgrade to the existing headers.
Impact: a few us CPU, and stops metrics handlers double-counting the event.

title: Parse runs the option pass twice; preset_names result usually discarded
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md

Where: image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/plug/request.ex:46-49 calls Parser.preset_names(lexed) (image_pipe_url/lib/image_pipe/api/parser.ex:71-75), which runs full parse_options/1; Presets.for_request/2 (image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/presets.ex:22-29) ignores the names when :preset_lookup is unset (default); Parser.parse/2 runs parse_options/1 again.
Measured (real parser code): simple URL 43.7 us total of which 12.7 us wasted; 3-group URL 109.2 us, 26.7 us wasted (~30% of parse CPU). Matters most for 304s and cache hits.
Fix: compute names only when a lookup is configured, or return parsed occurrences from one pass and feed parse/2.

title: Perf review: request path
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Two-pass decode so trim keeps shrink-on-load
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/decode_planner.ex:62 returns shrink 1.0 whenever a group trims, so trim + w=600 decodes the full source, materialises it, and runs find_trim over every pixel.
Measured: 24 MP baseline JPEG, trim then w=600: shrink 1 (current) 1315 ms, 2 = 475, 4 = 186, 8 = 103 ms (no trim at shrink 8: 73 ms).
Design: open a shrink-8 preview and run find_trim; plan the real shrink from the trimmed extent (+1 preview px margin); decode at that shrink, trim, rescale the box like region crops (Geometry.rescale_crop, executor.ex:227,235). Trim edges get shrink-pixel precision (<1 output px); edge detection may differ near threshold.
Needs decision: changes output pixels; needs a design note in docs/plans/ and re-baked trim goldens.

title: Cache SSIMULACRA2 tile references across crop-mode quality probes
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/output/ssim2_metric/crop_score.ex:101-105: tile_score/3 calls Ssim2Metric.reference(bt) on the base tile for every candidate; base image and 16 tile coords are fixed for the search.
Fix: build the 16 references once in EncodeSearch.score_opts/4 (crop path, encode_search.ex:626) and reuse.
Impact (inferred from bench/autoquality.md Part A): reference ~40% of tile cost; probe ~265 -> ~155 ms; saves ~0.4-0.6 s per search on >6 MP images, identical scores and output. Cheapest item; confirm by re-running Part E/L.

title: Perf review: image processing and encoding
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Signed URLs are malleable: each signature has 4 valid spellings
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

Where: image_pipe_url/lib/image_pipe/security/signature.ex:73 (decode_signature/1). Also bug-hunt/request-handling.md #2. Reproduced.
Cause: a 43-char base64url string encodes 32 bytes plus 2 unused bits; Base.url_decode64/2 ignores them, so four last characters decode to the same MAC. enc/ tokens already guard this with canonical_token/2 in source_encryption.ex.
Impact: no forgery, but each image is reachable at 4 URLs: fragments CDN/browser caches and defeats URL-keyed dedupe or allowlists.
Fix: re-encode the decoded bytes and require an exact match.

title: Bug hunt: URL builder (image_pipe_url)
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: CREDENTIALS__AUTH_TOKEN_FILE reads the rotating token once at boot
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: config/tree.ex:74 maps ...AUTH_TOKEN_FILE to auth_token; config/convert.ex:167-176 only renames to auth_token_file when the schema lacks auth_token, but container_credentials has both (image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/source/s3/container_credentials.ex).
Effect: the token is read once; after EKS Pod Identity rotates the file, credential refreshes and S3 requests fail. Contradicts docs/server-configuration.md:75-77, and suppresses the AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN_FILE fallback (config/sources.ex credentials_aws_environment).
Test: env tree with IPS_SOURCES__S3__CREDENTIALS__PROVIDER=container_credentials and ...AUTH_TOKEN_FILE=<tmp> yields auth_token: <contents> and no auth_token_file.
Fix: prefer name_file (as a path) when both name and name_file exist in the schema.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Empty signing-keys env var or secret file silently disables URL signing
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: config/convert.ex:121-126 (env lists split with trim: true) and :182-185 (_FILE contents trim_trailing'd).
Cause: empty IPS_URL__KEYS, IPS_URL__KEYS=",", or an empty/whitespace IPS_URL__KEYS_FILE gives keys: [], and the server serves unsigned URLs. server.auth_token rejects empty values, so this fails open inconsistently.
Test: Config.load!(%{"IPS_URL__KEYS_FILE" => empty_tmp_file}, "/nonexistent") succeeds with no keys.
Fix: reject env/_FILE list settings that parse to no entries ("expected at least one entry"); explicit keys = [] in TOML can stay valid.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Bug hunt: standalone server
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Revalidation never sends validators when origin varies on a header Req adds
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/source/req_stream.ex:98 calls Origin.conditional_headers(previous, request) on the Req.new request, before Req steps run; Origin.from_response stored Vary digests from response.request.headers after steps added authorization (auth:) and user-agent. matches?/2 (origin.ex:128-133) always fails.
Effect: with Vary: Authorization + req_options auth:, or Vary: User-Agent, no If-None-Match is sent; every revalidation downloads the full body.
Test: origin sending vary: Authorization + etag, answering 304 on if-none-match; second fetch via with_revalidated returns :not_modified.

title: Empty S3 revision sends ?versionId=
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Where: s3.ex:207 and :261 treat revision: "" as no revision; revision_query/1 at s3.ex:470-473 matches only nil, so "" builds ?versionId=.
Reach: s3://bucket/cat.jpg%3F decodes to a trailing ?, parser keeps query: "" as revision. AWS rejects empty versionId with 400; "" and nil also give different identities.
Fix: add a "" clause or normalise "" to nil in the parser.
Test: S3 fetch with revision: "" sends query_string == "".

title: Watermarked responses can advertise looser caching than the main source allows
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/execution.ex:501-512 reduces main and watermark states with Enum.min_by(states, &freshness/2); response/cache_policy.ex:140-163 takes revalidation and stale window from that single state.
Effect: main max-age=60 + watermark max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=86400 gives stale-while-revalidate=86400; main must-revalidate + watermark max-age=30 drops must-revalidate.
Fix: combine field by field (earliest fresh deadline, shortest stale window, strictest revalidation).
Test: wire test with two HTTP origins; assert cache-control has no stale-while-revalidate=86400.

title: Bug hunt: sources and caching
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Errors after processing starts replace the host's Vary header
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Where: image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/plug/runner.ex:134 -> with_policy_headers/2 -> put_resp_headers/2 (:254-261). Traced, not run.
Cause: when Execution.open fails (415/413/422/500/501/503), policy headers use put_resp_header, replacing an upstream Vary (Accept-Encoding, Origin) and turning Vary: * into Vary: Accept. Success and 304 paths merge via CacheHeaders.merge_vary/2 (cache_policy.ex:377).
Impact: a shared cache can serve one variant's error to other variants (e.g. reflected-origin CORS with Vary: Origin).
Test: copy the 'cache-miss stream encode failures ... preserve automatic Vary' test in plug_test.exs, add put_resp_header("vary", "Accept-Encoding"), assert ["Accept-Encoding, Accept"] (today ["Accept"]).

title: Preset with wm-enc crashes the request on a mount without source encryption keys
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Where: image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/plug/request.ex:105 and :111-117 (wm_enc_span/1). Traced, not run.
Cause: on :source_encryption_disabled the code finds the span with {offset, _} = :binary.match(path, "/wm-enc="). If wm-enc came from a preset, the raw path lacks it, :binary.match returns :nomatch and MatchError is raised.
Scenario: request_watermarks: true, presets: %{"wm" => "wm-enc=AQID..."}, no source_encryption_keys; GET /preset=wm/src/a.jpg raises instead of a 400 diagnostic.
Fix: fall back to the preset or whole-path span, or reject wm-enc presets at config time when encryption is disabled.

title: Bug hunt: request handling
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: processing_timeout above 60 s is ignored for image output
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/delivery/coordinator.ex:32,77 (code-checked).
Cause: Delivery.stream waits for the first chunk with a hard-coded 60 s call, returning {:session, :timeout} (not the documented {:processing, :timeout}). Non-image terminals honour the configured timeout, so the same config behaves differently by terminal.
Fix: use the configured processing_timeout and the documented error tag.

title: info terminal reports unclamped result dimensions
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/processing/terminal.ex:171-196.
Cause: the image path applies Output.Clamp (processing.ex:223); info never does. docs/processing/output.md:501 promises result matches the image the same URL would return. A 9000x3000 JPEG with default limits reports 9000x3000; the image response is 8192x2731.
Fix: apply Output.Clamp to info result dimensions.

title: Bug hunt: image processing and output
description: Findings from /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md (main 84eeac2). Static review/benchmarks; see the write-up for method and items checked and found sound.

title: Add libheif dav1d plugin for faster AVIF decode
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Where: Dockerfile:96 installs only libheif-plugin-aomdec/aomenc. With libheif-plugin-dav1d, libheif prefers it for decode.
Measured: 6000x4000 AVIF decode 0.73 -> 0.51 s wall. Don't add svtenc for encoding (3x slower than aom at default effort).

title: Source-record lookup goes through a full cache entry open
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: cache.ex:113-122 opens the body, hashes it, sends a hit cast and closes it just to read source_record, already in metadata; repeats the lookup prepare_remote just did (source_cache.ex:53).
Fix: read metadata only; skip the second lookup when the lock was uncontended.

title: S3 credentials read through a per-bucket GenServer on every request
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: source/s3/credentials.ex:32 and refresh_cache/entry.ex:254, including cache hits.
Fix: publish credentials to ETS or persistent_term. Related: auth: :netrc re-parses the netrc file every request.

title: Start the Req/Finch pool once instead of per fetch
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: source/req_stream.ex:290-316. Passing pool options makes Req call DynamicSupervisor.start_child on the single Req.FinchSupervisor per fetch, plus term_to_binary+md5 of options and Finch NimbleOptions validation, serialised VM-wide.
Fix: compute the pool name once, start once, pass finch: [name: ...]. Tens of us per fetch and one serialisation point removed.

title: Pools keyed by pinned IP lose keep-alive reuse and never expire
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: source/http/pinned_target.ex. Round-robin DNS spreads connections over many pools; no pool_max_idle_time, so pools for retired IPs persist.
Fix: stable-sort vetted addresses and set an idle timeout. Related: pool size fixed at Finch default 50, HTTP/1 only.

title: Two serial uncached DNS lookups on every fetch and redirect hop
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Where: source/http/target_guard.ex:48-68: getaddrs(:inet) then getaddrs(:inet6); pinning means warm keep-alive still pays both.
Fix: run in parallel and add a short-TTL cache by default. Saves 1-2 DNS round trips per miss or revalidation.

title: Fetch cookies only when storage_inputs names a cookie
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md

Where: plug/runner.ex:102 calls Plug.Conn.fetch_cookies/1 unconditionally; only Execution.Inputs.storage_material/2 (execution/inputs.ex:79) reads cookies, for storage_inputs: [{:cookie, _}].
Impact: inferred, few to tens of us with large analytics Cookie headers. One-line guard.

title: Miss-path streaming is lock-step, one round trip per encoder chunk
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md

Where: delivery/producer.ex:101-120 pulls one chunk per {:next, ...}; response/sender.ex:282-315 writes each before asking for the next; delivery/stream_pull.ex:28 forwards any non-empty binary.
Reasoning (not measured): libvips targets flush ~8 KB, so a 300 KB output is ~40 round trips and chunked writes with no encode/write overlap.
Fix: in pump_loop accumulate ~64 KB (or :done) before replying; optionally prefetch one chunk; keep the first chunk small for TTFB. Validate with a chunks-per-response counter on a real build first.

title: A/B libvips operation cache defaults in production vs benchmarks
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Nothing in lib/ or image_pipe_server/ calls Vix.Vips.cache_set_max*, so production runs libvips' default cache (100 ops/100 MB/100 files), while test/test_helper.exs:21 and every bench/*.exs disable it. For mostly-unique traffic it rarely hits and keeps intermediate buffers alive (resident memory). Committed memory/latency studies therefore don't describe production exactly.
Next: short A/B of bench/pre_clamp_materialization.exs with the cache on, then decide whether the server disables it or docs recommend it.

title: Run face and object detectors concurrently / share a pre-shrunk frame
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/detector/composite.ex:84 maps routed children sequentially; each image_vision preprocess/1 flattens, converts and thumbnails the frame itself.
Fix: run children concurrently (independent, return own regions), or at least give both one shared pre-shrunk frame.
Impact: inferred, likely tens of ms (face model time) when both route. Not measured (models unavailable).

title: Integer and float spellings give different canonical identity for crop, region and trim tolerance
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

Parser and builder. crop=10,20 vs crop=10.0,20.0, region=1,2,10,10, trim=red,10 vs trim=red,10.0 give different Specs. Builder crop: {10.0, 20} keeps 10.0 but its URL crop=10,20 parses to 10, so run/4 and the served URL build different Specs. Effect options already canonicalise this (canonical_property_test); these don't. Effect: duplicate cache entries, no wrong pixels.

title: -0.0 survives into the Spec for focus, region origin, trim tolerance, bg alpha, autoquality target/error
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

From the builder; focus=-0.0,... also in the parser. URL text is identical but terms differ on OTP 27+, giving cache-key drift.

title: Angles just below 0 normalize to 360.0 instead of 0.0
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

Where: option_spec.ex normalize_angle/1; builder plan/builder/values.ex normalize(_, :direction).
Cause: fmod(-1e-20, 360) + 360.0 rounds to 360.0. gradient=1,red,-0.000000000000000000001 gives 360.0 while gradient=1,red,360 gives 0.0; progressive-blur too. Builder direction: -1.0e-20 has angle 360.0 but its URL parses to 0.0.

title: Builder direction misses the parser's -0.0 -> 0.0 step
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

Where: plan/builder/values.ex :direction. direction: -360 gives -0.0 in the plan, the parser gives 0.0; different terms on OTP 27+.

title: Empty OTEL_* variables turn tracing on
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: tracing.ex:21-26 uses Map.has_key? and exporter != nil; the OTel spec says empty means unset.
Effect: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT= (common with Compose ${VAR}) enables OTLP export to localhost:4318 and logs connection errors; OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER= attaches the tracer with no exporter; OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=NONE (case-insensitive per spec) also enables it.
Test: Tracing.settings(%{"OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT" => ""}) returns enabled?: true today.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: server.port has no upper bound
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: config.ex:79 uses :non_neg_integer, so port = 70000 passes; Bandit then fails in the supervisor and the node crashes instead of a one-line invalid configuration error.
Test: Config.build!(server: [port: 70_000]) should raise ConfigError.
Fix: {:in, 0..65_535}.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Bearer auth scheme matched case-sensitively
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: router.ex:66 only accepts "Bearer " <> token. RFC 9110 11.1 makes the scheme case-insensitive; Authorization: bearer <token> gets 401.
Test: request with authorization: bearer secret against a router with auth_token_hash should succeed.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Docker HEALTHCHECK only follows IPS_SERVER__PORT
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/standalone-server.md

Where: Dockerfile:126-127 curls 127.0.0.1:${IPS_SERVER__PORT:-8080}. With port set in TOML or IPS_SERVER__PORT_FILE the check hits 8080, the container stays unhealthy, and Swarm etc. restart-loop it.
Fix: a bin/image_pipe_server health command/rpc that reads the loaded port, or document the constraint.

Note: fixed in a local, unpushed commit on branch claude/fix-server-bugs-tpeoil (project thread 'Fix standalone server bugs').

title: Dot segments in S3 keys are sent literally
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Plausible, test before acting. s3.ex:462-468 leaves . and .. unencoded and the parser doesn't reject them. s3://allowed/..%2Fother%2Fx.jpg requests /allowed/../other/x.jpg signed with allowed's credentials. AWS treats keys literally, but a normalising proxy or S3-compatible gateway would serve a bucket outside the allowlist.

title: Large outputs rejected for storage lose request dedup
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Plausible, test before acting. delivery/coordinator.ex:326-327 completes the flight as :ready even when the commit was rejected by admission, skipped by max_body_bytes, or never opened. Every waiter then misses the cache and regenerates; on a full bounded cache N concurrent requests for a large new key decode/encode N times.

title: Atom header names with underscores bypass header deny lists
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Plausible, test before acting. req_sanitizer.ex:29-33 and req_stream.ex:223-227 compare to_string(name), so accept_encoding never matches accept-encoding. If Req turns _ into - for atom names (unconfirmed), headers: [accept_encoding: "gzip"] reaches origins for immutable sources and proxy_authorization survives cross-origin redirects.

title: Timeout before response headers is reported as 502, not 504
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Where: req_stream.ex:146-147: before headers, every request error becomes :connect_error; only a body timeout maps to :receive_timeout (req_stream.ex:277).
Effect: an origin that accepts but never responds yields 502, though receive_timeout documents that case as 504.
Test: raw socket that accepts and never writes, receive_timeout: 100; expect {:source, :receive_timeout}.

title: Accept q=0. is read as q=1, so a refused format is served
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Where: image_pipe/lib/image_pipe/output/negotiation.ex:99-104 (parse_quality/1). Also reported in bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md #12.
Cause: RFC 9110 12.4.2 allows qvalue "0.". Float.parse("0.") returns {0.0, "."}, misses the {q, ""} clause, and falls back to 1.0. Accept: image/webp;q=0., image/jpeg gets WebP.
Test: assert Negotiation.modern_candidates("image/webp;q=0.", []) == [].
Fix: parse against ~r/\A(0(\.\d{0,3})?|1(\.0{0,3})?)\z/.

title: ImagePipe.validate/2 misses watermark-source errors
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/run.ex:105-112 (code-checked).
Cause: validate/2 skips Execution.watermark_sources/2, a pure parse run/4 does before reading. watermark_source: "ftp://x/y.png" validates :ok but run/4 returns {:invalid_source, {:unsupported_scheme, "ftp"}}.
Fix: call Execution.watermark_sources/2 in validate/2.

title: output=blurhash shrink-on-load changes fixed-pixel effects
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/executor.ex:770-774.
Cause: a single-group blurhash decodes at up to 1/8. Crop coordinates are rescaled, but padding, watermark size, pixelate block size and blur/sharpen sigma are not, so pad=200/output=blurhash on a 4000x3000 photo pads ~45% of the frame instead of ~5%.
Fix: rescale fixed-pixel parameters too, or skip shrink-on-load when such effects are present.

title: pixelate averages alpha without premultiplying
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/operation/pixelate.ex:47.
Cause: blocks straddling a transparent edge pick up the colour of transparent pixels (usually black). Blur, sharpen and progressive blur all use AlphaPremultiply.with_alpha_premultiplied.
Fix: wrap in AlphaPremultiply.with_alpha_premultiplied.

title: bitonal on 16-bit RGBA gives near-black output
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/transform/operation/bitonal.ex:34-41.
Cause: colour bands become 8-bit 0/255 and are bandjoined back with the ushort alpha without rescaling. gray.ex and brightness.ex handle USHORT; bitonal doesn't.
Trigger: hdr=preserve/bitonal/format=png on a 16-bit RGBA PNG.
Fix: handle USHORT like gray.ex/brightness.ex.

title: JPEG encoder limit is 65,535 but libjpeg's maximum is 65,500
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/output/encoder.ex:29 (code-checked).
Cause: only reachable when a host raises max_result_width/height above 65,500: an axis of 65,501-65,535 passes the clamp and jpegsave fails with a 500.
Fix: use 65,500 as the JPEG limit.

title: Turn off scheduler busy-waiting in the release
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

No rel/vm.args.eex, so +sbwt medium (and dirty equivalents) apply; spinning schedulers take CPU from libvips threads. Try +sbwt none +sbwtdcpu none +sbwtdio none; needs a load test on the real image.

title: GC Bandit connection processes after every keep-alive request
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/standalone-server.md

Where: lib/image_pipe_server/application.ex:90. Bandit HTTP/1 forces GC every 5 keep-alive requests by default (per docs, unverified on 1.12.5); MB-sized refc bodies can stay pinned on idle connections. Set http_1_options: [gc_every_n_keepalive_requests: 1]. Measure before adopting.

title: Cache key and ETag hash the same material separately; represent runs 2-3x per request
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

representation.ex:59-70. Cost is microseconds.

title: Store path validation re-runs NimbleOptions and safe_relative per call
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

store.ex:796-808, :889-900.

title: Open cache and source files with :raw
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

cache/file.ex:11, store.ex:263, source/file.ex:221-226 open without :raw: each open spawns an I/O process and each chunk is a message round trip.

title: Eviction-gated commits copy whole queues to lists
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

admission.ex:699-701, :733, :513-525: commit copies queues to lists then deletes victims inside the GenServer. Use a lazy walk capped at ~64 entries.

title: Buffer spool writes (~64 KB) instead of one write per network message
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

source_cache.ex:313-341: each network message is one :file.write plus one Download.advance call.

title: Cold copied originals are written and hashed twice
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/sources-and-caching.md

Spooling goes to System.tmp_dir! then streams into the pool sink (source_cache.ex:250, :297-327; input.ex:558-577). Spool into the pool directory and adopt by rename instead.

title: Small request-path CPU cleanups
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/request-path.md

Bundle with other work. Measured per item:
- Telemetry.telemetry_opts/1 Keyword.take over ~80 config keys at every span (~10/request), telemetry.ex:365: 1.5 us/call; compute prefix once per request (~15 us).
- OptionSpec.fetch/1 linear Enum.find over 70 specs, api/option_spec.ex:688: 2.4 us vs 0.26 us with a compile-time map.
- src percent-escape check uses a module-attribute regex, api/path.ex:33,303: 1.5 us vs 0.17 us binary scan.
- Response header merge O(n^2) with repeated String.downcase, response/sender.ex:370-425: a few us.
- Default Logger handler builds the message before Logger.log, telemetry/logger.ex:145-158: move the build inside the fn.

title: Add a baseline (non-progressive) JPEG fixture for benchmarks
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/perf-review/image-processing.md

Every JPEG in priv/static/images/ is progressive; libjpeg DCT shrink helps those little (spinning.jpg 24 MP: 344 ms at shrink 1, 276 ms at shrink 8). Benches built on them understate shrink-on-load gains and overstate decode cost. Add a baseline copy of one large fixture.

title: Finish URL builder bug hunt coverage
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/url-builder.md

The bug hunt stopped early. Not yet covered: preset expansion (plan/presets.ex), validate_against/validate_known, encrypted watermark round trip through decrypt, diagnostic renderer and format detector, and a StreamData version of the builder round-trip probe (build URL -> Path.extract -> Parser.parse vs Plan.to_spec). Also: canonical_property_test.exs:219 failed on OTP 25, probably a -0.0 artifact; confirm on OTP 29.

title: Investigate: allowed_hosts checks host only, not port
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

http.ex:351: any port on an allowed host is reachable, including via redirects. May be intended.

title: Investigate: leftover cache files after an Admission commit timeout
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/sources-and-caching.md

Admission.call/2 uses the default 5 s timeout. If it fires mid-publish, the .body file can be renamed into place without its .meta, and bounded accounting never counts it.

title: CORS gaps: no Allow-Headers on OPTIONS, no Expose-Headers for ETag/Content-Disposition
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Design gap rather than bug. No Access-Control-Allow-Headers on OPTIONS, so a cross-origin fetch sending If-None-Match fails preflight. No Access-Control-Expose-Headers for ETag or Content-Disposition.

title: Investigate: must-revalidate alongside stale-while-revalidate cancels the stale window
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

cache_policy.ex cap_control/3 adds must-revalidate alongside stale-while-revalidate, which effectively cancels the stale window. Documented, so may be intended.

title: Investigate: commas inside quoted Accept parameters drop q=0
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

Plug.Conn.Utils.list/1 splits image/webp;x="a,b";q=0 on the comma, dropping the q=0. Exotic header shape.

title: Investigate: HEAD on file-backed cache hits
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/request-handling.md

response/sender.ex:131-137 sets content-length then either sends an empty body or uses send_chunked. Whether that's correct depends on the adapter (Bandit/Cowboy); not checked without deps.

title: Investigate: SSIMULACRA2/Butteraugli NIFs with 4-band CMYK
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Not confirmed. CMYK JPEG + profile=preserve + perceptual autoquality could fail if the metric NIFs don't accept 4-band input. Needs the NIF source.

title: Investigate: 1px tie-rounding mismatch for focus-point crops under mirrored deferred orientation
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Real but very narrow, per the bug hunt. Not further located.

title: Auto-quality byte-budget phase mislabels its result when the iteration budget is spent
description:
Source: /mnt/project-files/bug-hunt/image-processing-and-output.md

Where: lib/image_pipe/output/encode_search.ex:299-310.
Cause: with a small autoquality_max_iterations plus max-bytes, the first cap probe returns :capped and the search jumps to the floor, labelling it :best_effort/:max_bytes even if a higher quality would fit. Metadata and telemetry only.
